description: Bring the copies of an entity template in this account's projects up to its newest version. Without reportId it only reports, per project: what the template changed that the project did not (taken), what the project changed itself (kept, e.g. a moved ship keeps its position), scripts changed on both sides (kept: code is never merged), parts the template added, and parts it removed (kept unless removeGone: true). With that reportId it applies the report to the projects, as undoable changes every open editor sees; if anything moved since, nothing is changed and the new report is returned. projectIds limits it to those projects (default: every project holding a copy). Published releases never change. Applying needs the template:update right.

projectIds.description: Only these projects (default: every project of the account holding a copy).

removeGone.description: Also remove the parts the newest version no longer has (default false: kept and listed). Plan with it and apply that report with it.

reportId.description: The report being applied, from this tool without reportId. Leave it out to plan.

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.
